newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bomb wounds two pro-Israeli militiamen in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Bomb wounds two pro-Israeli militiamen in Lebanon.

text.p: A roadside bomb wounded two pro-Israeli militiamen and four civilians in south Lebanon on Monday, security sources with the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia said.

The bomb exploded beside an SLA patrol near Khirbeh village in the eastern sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, they said. The wounded civilians were in a car behind the patrol, the sources added.
In Beirut, a spokesman for the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) claimed responsibility for the attack. Five SLA men have been killed and 18 wounded in guerrilla attacks this year.
Hizbollah is trying to oust Israeli troops and the SLA from a 15-km (nine miles) wide border occupation zone in south Lebanon.
